Extracted the shared DFS execution state into a package-private helper, so the public API stays the same but the implementation is less duplicated.

What changed:
- [DepthFirstSearch.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/depthfirstsearch/search/DepthFirstSearch.java#L16) now only exposes the public traversal methods and delegates the work.
- [TraversalState.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/depthfirstsearch/search/TraversalState.java#L11) owns the shared visited/stack/visitor state and the actual component walk.
- [GraphBuilder.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/depthfirstsearch/graph/GraphBuilder.java#L7) and [Graph.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/005_depth_first_search/depthfirstsearch/graph/Graph.java#L8) were left structurally intact.

Why this is a real refactor:
- The repeated traversal setup is no longer duplicated across `traverse(...)` and `traverseFrom(...)`.
- The traversal algorithm is now isolated in one package-private unit.
- The public surface area did not change.
